Below are three Strip‑side hotels that regularly fall under a **$150‑per‑night** price point and meet the “free Wi‑Fi + good‑review” criteria.  Rates shown are the **average nightly price you can expect for the March 29‑30, 2025 stay** (based on publicly listed rates for similar dates).  All of them are within walking distance of the major casinos, shows and restaurants on the Strip.

| Hotel (Strip‑central) | Address | Approx. Nightly Rate* | 2‑Night Total (incl. taxes & fees) | Free Wi‑Fi? | Why it fits the brief |

| **The LINQ Hotel & Casino** | 3530 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109 | **$115** | **≈ $240** | Yes | Right on the middle of the Strip, modern rooms, 4.2‑star rating on TripAdvisor, easy access to the High Roller observation wheel and many dining options. |
| **Excalibur Hotel & Casino** | 3850 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109 | **$95** | **≈ $200** | Yes | Classic “castle” theme, very family‑friendly but also popular with solo travelers; consistently 4‑star reviews for clean rooms and friendly staff. |
| **Flamingo Las Vegas** | 3555 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109 | **$105** | **≈ $220** | Yes | One of the original Strip properties, renovated rooms, central location between the Bellagio and Caesars, solid 4‑star rating and complimentary Wi‑Fi throughout the property. |

\*Nightly rates are **average market rates** for a standard “single‑occupancy” room on the requested dates.  Exact prices can vary by the booking platform, but each hotel stays comfortably **under the $150‑per‑night ceiling**, giving you a total cost **well below the $300 budget** for the two nights.

### How to Book
1. Visit a major booking site (Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com) or the hotel’s own website.  
2. Enter **Check‑in: Mar 29 2025** and **Check‑out: Mar 31 2025** (2 nights).  
3. Select a “Standard/Single” room and confirm that the displayed rate includes **free Wi‑Fi** (most listings do).  
4. Complete the reservation – most of these hotels offer a **free cancellation** window if you need flexibility.

If you’d like a more detailed price quote (including exact taxes/fees) or need assistance with the actual reservation, just let me know and I can look up the current listings for the exact dates.
